title_en: A Day in the Life of a Delivery Rider
note_en: 不是A，而是B corrects an assumption: "it's not A, it's B." Lao Wang uses it twice: 最怕的不是风吹日晒，而是顾客给的差评 "what he fears most isn't wind and sun but a bad review," and 最难熬的不是辛苦，而是几乎没有…周末 "the hardest part isn't the hard work but having almost no weekends." The two halves must be parallel, and 而是 (not 但是) introduces the real answer.
